articles.summary: MOLINE, Ill., Aug. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - QCR Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: QCRH) (the “Company”) today announced that on August 20, 2026, the Company’s Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.15 per share payable on October 5, 2026, to stockholders of record on September 18, 2026. This dividend represents an increase from the prior quarterly dividend of $0.10 per share and reflects the Company’s strong financial performance, disciplined approach to capital management, and the Board’s confidence in the Company’s long-term outlook. “This marks our second dividend increase in 2026, reflecting the strength of our balance sheet, consistent earnings performance, and commitment to delivering long-term value to our shareholders,” said Todd A. Gipple, President and CEO. About Us QCR Holdings, Inc., headquartered in Moline, Illinois, is a relationship-driven, multi-bank holding company serving the Quad Cities, Cedar Rapids, Cedar Valley, Des Moines/Ankeny and Springfield
articles.title: QCR Holdings, Inc. Announces Increased Cash Dividend of $0.15 Per Share
